requirements.statement: Team leads can view the members of their team.
requirements.source_quote: Team leads can view the members of their team.
ambiguity_notes: Which member details are visible is not stated.
Whether a team lead can lead or belong to more than one team is not stated.
How team membership is defined is not stated.

requirements.statement: Team leads can reset a team member's password.
requirements.source_quote: Team leads can reset a team member's password.
ambiguity_notes: It is not stated whether the lead sets a new password or triggers a reset link or temporary password.
It is not stated whether a lead can reset the password of another team lead or of members outside their own team.
Notification of the member and audit trail are not stated.

requirements.statement: Users can change their own display name.
requirements.source_quote: Users can change their own display name.
ambiguity_notes: Display name rules (length, allowed characters, uniqueness) are not stated.
Where the display name is shown and how often it can be changed is not stated.

clarifying_questions.question: Which details of each team member should a team lead see?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Determines the data exposed and the content of the view.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: The member view cannot be specified; personal data may be over- or under-exposed.

clarifying_questions.question: How is a team defined, and can a person lead or belong to more than one team?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Sets the scope of what a team lead may view and act on.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Permission scope for viewing and password reset cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: When a team lead resets a password, do they choose the new password, or does the system send the member a reset link or temporary password?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Security-relevant behaviour: determines whether the lead ever knows the member's credentials.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: The reset behaviour cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: Are there limits on password reset, such as resetting another team lead's password, member notification or an audit record?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Resetting a password changes access to another person's account and affects security.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Permission boundaries and safeguards for the reset are undefined.

clarifying_questions.question: What rules apply to a display name (length, allowed characters, uniqueness) and where is it shown?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Defines validation and the places affected by a change.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Validation and display behaviour are left undefined.

proposed_status_changes.reason: Team definition and visible member details are missing.
Reset mechanism and permission boundaries are missing.
